يبتاعوا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَاعُوا (yabtāʕū) /jab.taː.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَاعَ (ibtāʕa)
# يُبْتَاعُوا (yubtāʕū) /jub.taː.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَاعَ (ibtāʕa)
